title: A Busy Week Starts with a Bounce
summary: Friday was an ugly day for many. A selloff in technology stocks led to substantial declines in the S&P 500 (SPX, -1.82%) and Nasdaq 100 (NDX, -3.46%), even after a substantial bounce in the last hour of the day. Today, investors are starting the new month with a better mindset.
